page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a narrow column of marginal notes runs down the right margin (cut off at the scan edge). Running head "ΘΕΣ" centred at top; page number 222 at top left.

main_text.p: {*}ἡ ον. a.1.pass. ἐθεάθλωσ ἡ confpectus fui, a.1.pass.infin. θεαθλῶσαι, spectari.
Θεατρίζω in theatrum omnibus spectandum produco. F.ίσω. P. τεθεατρισμένος. praef.pass. θεατρίζομαι, in theatrum producor ignominiae causa, Heb.10.33. pras.pass. τεθεατρισμαι.
Θεῖος εἶα εἶον divinus a um, 2.Pet.1.4. τὸ θεῖον, numen, Act.17.29.
Θειότης ητος ἡ divinitas, divina majestas, Roman.1.20.
Θειώδης ες ὁ ἡ sulphureus a, Apoc.9.17.

Θέλω ἐθέλω volo, delector Matt.27.43. opto Marc.10.35. εἰ θέλει αὐτὸν, si vult eum, h.e. si delectatur eo, Luc.1.62. τί αὐ θέλοι (3.sing. praef.act.opt.) Act.17.18. imperf. ἤθελον ες ἐ. & pro hoc ὧν θέλων cupiebat enim, Luc.23.8. F. θελήσω. pra.act. τεθέληκα. a.1.act. ἠθέλησα. Attice Act.16.3. Luc.10.24. volui. item cupivi Luc.10.24. a.1. act.subj. θελήσω ης ἡ 1.Cor.4.19. ἐὰν Κύριος θελήσῃ, si Dominus voluerit.
Θέλημα τὸ voluntas, libido 1.Pet.4.3. θελήματα ων τα voluntates Act.13.22.
Θεμελιόω ω fundo, fundamentum jacio. Fut. ώσω. P. τεθεμελίωμαι. aor.1. act. ἐθεμελίωσα. aor.1.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right edge are cut off and largely illegible; only fragments such as "Matth.", "Deus", "Heb.", "Luc.18", "Rom.11.19", "Act.23.9" are discernible and are not transcribed. Greek accents and breathings are approximate given the scan quality.
